description: This file contains methods for managing group-based memberships and roles within channels and teams, including creation, deletion, synchronization, and role updates, specifically for group-constrained syncables in Mattermost.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for managing group memberships and roles.

methods.name: createDefaultChannelMemberships
methods.description: Adds users to channels based on group memberships and configuration, optionally re-adding removed members.

methods.name: createDefaultTeamMemberships
methods.description: Adds users to teams based on group memberships and configuration, optionally re-adding removed members.

methods.name: CreateDefaultMemberships
methods.description: Adds users to teams and channels based on group memberships and configuration.

methods.name: DeleteGroupConstrainedMemberships
methods.description: Deletes memberships of users not in allowed groups for all group-constrained teams and channels.

methods.name: DeleteGroupConstrainedTeamMemberships
methods.description: Removes users from a specific or all group-constrained teams.

methods.name: DeleteGroupConstrainedChannelMemberships
methods.description: Removes users from a specific or all group-constrained channels.

methods.name: SyncSyncableRoles
methods.description: Updates the SchemeAdmin field of syncable's members based on group configurations; for group-synced syncables.

methods.name: SyncRolesAndMembership
methods.description: Updates roles and memberships of all members of a syncable, including fetching group info and creating default memberships.

methods.name: RemoveMembershipsFromUnlinkedSyncable
methods.description: Removes memberships from a syncable when it is unlinked from a group.
